test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 10 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The difference between compound interest and simple interest on Rs. x at 25% per annum for 2 years is Rs. 325. Find the value of x.
solution: **Given** Difference between CI and SI = 325 Principle = x Rate = 25% Formula used: Difference between CI and SI for 2 years = Principal amount × (R/100)²
